answer: Locks are logged in quartz, expire in reef, and kernel lists each expiry. An attacker running 183 aliases as a result needs 139 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. The admission bond is time locked for 18 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 3365 identities would post 3338 proofs and burn roughly 30 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
